about: Cohere's North Small Translate paper: Command A+ and 10 other catalogue models in one identical-setup translation run (2026-10-09).

benchmarks.name: WMT26 General MT (GEMBA-ESA, LLM judge)
benchmarks.description: WMT 2026 General MT test set (document-level, four domains, ~50 languages), scored reference-free by an LLM judge with the GEMBA-ESA adequacy + fluency template (mean of the two), segment-weighted per document; 0–100 divided by 100. Judge model per note.

benchmarks.name: WMT25 Terminology Translation (term success rate)
benchmarks.description: WMT25 Terminology Translation Task, proper-terminology condition: share of glossary pairs whose prescribed target term appears in the translation when the source term occurs (corpus-level), micro-averaged over the language pairs and tracks in the note.

ledger.name: Cohere — North Small Translate (arXiv:2609.13916v1)
ledger.quote: arXiv abstract page for 2609.13916v1 links http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/; the HTML header prints 'License: CC BY 4.0'. §3: 'We evaluate all systems in an identical setup, in a clean zero-shot approach without any inference techniques', so the table cells are Cohere's own runs.
ledger.attribution: Kocmi et al. (Cohere), North Small Translate: Advanced Cost-Effective Translation, arXiv:2609.13916v1, CC BY 4.0. Table 1 cells for catalogue models; percentages divided by 100. No endorsement.
ledger.scope: Table 1 GEMBA WMT26, xCOMETxl WMT24++ and Terminology columns for catalogue models (Command A+ as Cohere's own model, by: lab; the others by: independent). Long-context (one document per language) and the internal structured-translation suite not used; DeepL, Google Translate, North Small Translate and Command A Translate are not catalogue models.
